g.text: Passive 10k-100k pot only. Sleeve = GND. JP301: both shunts 1-3 / 2-4 for tip wiper; 3-5 / 4-6 for ring wiper.

g.desc: Passive 10k-100k pot only. Sleeve = GND. JP301: both shunts 1-3 / 2-4 for tip wiper; 3-5 / 4-6 for ring wiper.

g.text: JP302: 1-2 = 0x48; 2-3 = 0x49. Never leave ADDR floating. JP303/304 enable local 2.2k I2C pull-ups.

g.desc: JP302: 1-2 = 0x48; 2-3 = 0x49. Never leave ADDR floating. JP303/304 enable local 2.2k I2C pull-ups.

g.text: Remove BOTH pull-up shunts when host already has pull-ups (Raspberry Pi). Start at 100 kHz I2C.

g.desc: Remove BOTH pull-up shunts when host already has pull-ups (Raspberry Pi). Start at 100 kHz I2C.

g.text: ADS1115: +/-4.096 V, 128 SPS. Read AIN0 and AIN1; normalize AIN0/AIN1, calibrate endpoints and smooth.
